project.name: Home2 Suites by Hilton, Eagle Pass TX
project.scope: Floor 1 King row: rooms 104, 106, 108, 110, 112, 114, 116, 118. The odd (Queen-Queen) row on the other side of Guest Corridor 121 is NOT covered here.

purpose: One machine-usable geometry spec for the King family so a 3D builder derives nothing. Every dimension carries a status and a citation. Nothing marked UNPROVEN may be invented - render it honestly or leave it out. Ruling D7: every room renders its own CORRECT geometry or an honest hard-stop, never a relabeled shell.

units.also_given: ft_in string, for reading against the sheets
units.pdf_scale_a550_a552: 1/4" = 1'-0", 18.000 PDF units per foot at 72 units/inch

status_vocabulary.PRINTED: A dimension string printed on the sheet, closed against the sheet's own vector geometry to within 0.25". The measured value is carried alongside as measured_in.
status_vocabulary.MEASURED: Not printed. Read directly off a wall-face line, a door opening or a tick pair in the sheet's vector geometry this run. Trustworthy to about 1/8", but it is a scaled dimension and A100 general note 4 says do not scale.
status_vocabulary.VERIFIED: Printed and independently confirmed by a second view or elevation on the same sheet.
status_vocabulary.DERIVED: Arithmetic on printed values, or a printed value restated against a different datum. The arithmetic is shown in the note.
status_vocabulary.SCALED: Taken off the drawn linework because the sheet prints nothing. Replace from the sheet named in cite. Do not build off these without confirming.
status_vocabulary.UNPROVEN: The sheets consulted do not answer it. in and ft_in are null. Do NOT fill these in by proportion.

frame.description: Per-room right-handed plan frame, feet-and-inches, origin at the corner where the corridor wall meets the bed/sofa wall. This is the SAME frame platform/king-studio.html already uses, so its constants drop straight in.
frame.x: 0 at the BED/SOFA wall room face; +x toward the WORKING wall room face. x = W at the working wall.
frame.z: 0 at the CORRIDOR wall room face; +z toward the WINDOW wall. z = D at the window wall.
frame.acc_mod_z_datum: Room 118's corridor wall JOGS. z = 0 is the corridor wall face on the WORKING / ENTRY side (the 29'-0" one). The bath-end corridor wall is at z = 1'-1 3/4".
frame.all_faces_are_room_faces: Every x/z value in this spec is to a ROOM-SIDE FINISH FACE unless the field name or note says centreline, stud face or grid.

hand.as-drawn: The room is built exactly as A550 / A552 draw it: standing in the corridor doorway looking into the room, the BED/SOFA wall is on your LEFT and the WORKING wall on your RIGHT, and the bathroom is on the LEFT in the entry zone.
hand.mirrored: The room is the mirror image: reflect the whole type through the plane x = W/2. Working wall on your LEFT entering, bed/sofa wall and bathroom on your RIGHT.
hand.how_to_apply: Reflect geometry, not labels. After mirroring, the wall this spec calls the working wall is still the working wall - it has just moved to the other side. Do not renumber the elevations.
hand.why_it_alternates: Guestrooms on the King row pair up so that adjacent rooms share either two working walls or two bed/sofa walls, which is what lets a connecting door land in one wall serving both keys. A100 shows the pattern unbroken from 104 through 118.

conflicts_and_cautions.what: GR-3 connecting-door centreline between rooms 116 and 118 disagrees by about 3/4".
conflicts_and_cautions.detail: A550 view 01.1 prints 11'-0" from the corridor wall INSIDE FACE (measured 198.18 units = 11'-0.01"). A552 prints 11'-7 1/2" from the corridor-end GRID LINE, which restates to 11'-0 13/16" from that room's corridor wall face (measured 209.16 units). It is one physical opening. Model 118 from A552 and 116 from A550 as this spec carries them, and flag the 3/4" for the architect - do not silently average.

conflicts_and_cautions.what: A552.md on Drive states the A552 room is '17'-6" x 18'-11"'. It is not.
conflicts_and_cautions.detail: 18'-11" is ONE SEGMENT of the 30'-1 1/2" grid-to-grid depth chain, not an overall. Measured this run: the chain is 18'-11" + 10'-0 3/4" + 1'-2", and the room's clear depth is 29'-0" on the entry side and 27'-10 1/4" at the bathroom. A552.md also lists the room's dimension strings as an undifferentiated grab-bag ('Other dims on the sheet: 30'-1 1/2", 11'-7 1/2", ...'). Use THIS spec, not A552.md, for A552 geometry. The same class of error was already found and corrected in A550.md.

No King-family sheet gives a 9'-0" ceiling anywhere. Main room is 8'-3 3/8" MINIMUM, bath and entry leg 7'-3" MINIMUM, per keynote 31 on both A550 and A552. The QQ family already has correct geometry in room3d.html and must not be broken; just do not inherit its ceiling constant.

conflicts_and_cautions.what: A552 view 01 keynote 5 calls the shower a tempered-glass ENCLOSURE; view 03 calls the same fixture a ROLL-IN with T-02 tile.
conflicts_and_cautions.detail: A curbless roll-in and a glass-door enclosure are not the same detail. Austin ruling D19 makes room 118 Configuration B, the roll-in, for construction. A100 and G001 still mark it 'T' (tub) and conflicts.md A11 / B4.4 are open. Reproduce as drawn, resolve against A532 / A532.1 before ordering.

conflicts_and_cautions.what: A550's specified GR-202 nightstand sconces are not what is in the room.
conflicts_and_cautions.detail: A550 elevation 07 specifies GR-202 nightstand sconces at 4'-4" AFF. The room-110 photographs show floor-standing chrome globe lamps beside the nightstands instead. Drawing governs what was specified; photograph governs what is there. Decide which the render is claiming to be.

conflicts_and_cautions.what: Bathroom-interior clear width for the standard King Studio has two competing scaled values.
conflicts_and_cautions.detail: The A550 vector extraction scales 5'-6 5/8"; platform/king-studio.html carries 5'-6 7/8" (BX minus a 4 3/4" scaled partition). A550 prints neither. The 1/4" spread is the size of the uncertainty. Replace both from A530.

conflicts_and_cautions.what: Finish code sets do not map one to one.
conflicts_and_cautions.detail: A550/A552 use the architect's PT-01/02/03/04, WC-01, CPT-01/02, T-01/T-02, PL-01, ST-01. ID-5.1 (dated 07/04/2025, later) uses SF-02, PT-02, PT-04, WC-01, ST-01, CPT-01.1, T-01.1, TL-01.1, PL-01 for the same surfaces. Reconcile against the finish schedule before assigning colours or textures.

conflicts_and_cautions.what: A552's two 17'-6" chains each sum to 17'-6 1/2".
conflicts_and_cautions.detail: The window-wall chain prints 3'-4" + 6'-0" + 8'-2 1/2" = 17'-6 1/2", and the corridor-end chain prints 3'-6 1/2" + 3'-4" R.O. + 10'-8" = 17'-6 1/2". The overall on both prints 17'-6". Measured, the true centreline-to-centreline is 17'-6 3/16" and each sub-dimension is within 0.25" of its print, so the 1/2" is accumulated printed rounding, not a real half inch. Build from the measured clear width of 16'-10" and the x positions in this spec; do not add the printed chain up.

conflicts_and_cautions.what: Room 118's clear width and depth are MEASURED, not printed.
conflicts_and_cautions.detail: A552 prints 17'-6" centreline-to-centreline and 18'-3 1/2" CLEAR for the main room, and nothing else as an overall clear. The 16'-10" clear width, the 29'-0" entry-side depth and the 27'-10 1/4" bath-side depth in this spec were read off wall-face lines in the sheet's vectors this run. They close exactly (303.000 and 522.03 and 501.39 units) and are corroborated twice - by view 02's own wall lines and, for the 17'-6", by A100 - but A100 general note 4 says do not use scaled dimensions. Confirm the clear width with the architect or a field tape before anything is fabricated to it.

conflicts_and_cautions.what: A552 elevation heights were transcribed, not measured.
conflicts_and_cautions.detail: This run closed A552 views 01 and 02 against the vectors. The elevation 05-08 mounting heights carried in this spec come from the A552 text layer and A552.md and were NOT independently closed. Re-measure before modelling device positions on room 118.
